text: On Jack's GPU the server cannot render into a linear XRGB8888 dmabuf: binding it fails with 'Failed to bind Framebuffer', and GBM reports the buffer's modifier as INVALID. So decade reads frames back through the renderer (copy_framebuffer) instead of mapping a linear buffer: decade script in read in src/script.rs, and the screenshot tool in src/server/compositor/screenshot.rs, which renders into a GlesRenderbuffer. Found by trial on 2026-11-07.
